name: Walk to Westerbork
summary:
When a young girl's life is brutally interrupted by the German invasion of the Netherlands, luck and defiance will ensure her survival of the Holocaust.

Created by the Illinois Holocaust Museum and production company East City Films, Walk to Westerbork is a remarkable virtual reality experience told through an intensely personal account of a young girl's survival during the Holocaust. Audiences accompany Rodi Glass as she revisits the sights of her survival from Amsterdam, Westerbork transit camp, and Vitt
